records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no tickets, and zero inbound replies to onboarding [email:39dbab06] or nurture [email:f917b209]; kickoff held [calendar:3ee307db] but produced no product activity, suggesting low unaided momentum in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Picking up from our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. A natural next step is your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
